programs.title: The Mysterious Cities Of Gold
programs.desc: Our heroes are surrounded by a troop of Bedouins. Their intrigued chief observed the medallion and then returned it to Zia apologizing for the young thief: a Bedouin never flies.

programs.title: Bushwhacked
programs.desc: Fraser Island in Queensland beckons and so too does the need to sustain the predator that calls the World Heritage site home.

programs.title: Motown Magic
programs.desc: Angie wants to turn back time to when her parents were together, so Ben helps her enter Street Art World to seek guidance from a wise graffiti oracle.

programs.title: The Magic Canoe
programs.desc: Nico doesn't listen to Viola's warnings and ends up losing his precious turquoise stone during the adventure. In the future, he promises to be more attentive to the advice of the greats.

programs.title: Spartakus And The Sun Beneath The Sea
programs.desc: Old Doctor Test, in his laboratory, tries unsuccessfully to bring back his fiance, who disappeared thirty years ago during an experiment. Suddenly, he sees the face of Arkana, lookalike of his beloved.

programs.title: The World According To Grandpa
programs.desc: Louie asks 'Who invented words?' and Grandpa spins a tall tale about Flaximus, a young boy from Ancient Rome who won the job of dreaming up a name for every single thing in the world!
